theory.title: Preguntas personales con el verbo be
theory.explanation: Ya conoces am, is y are en frases afirmativas. Ahora aprende a convertirlas en preguntas: coloca am, is o are antes del sujeto (Are you…? Is she…?). Para preguntar por un dato concreto, añade una palabra interrogativa al principio: What is your name? How old are you? Where are you from? y Where is he from? Responde con frases breves: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. / Yes, she is. / No, she isn't. No uses do o does con estas preguntas cuando el verbo principal es be. Para hablar de la edad en inglés se usa be: How old are you? — I'm twenty. Para el lugar de origen se usa be + from.
theory.tip: En preguntas con be no añadas do: Are you a student? (no Do you are a student?). En las respuestas cortas repite be: Yes, I am; no digas solo Yes, I.

patterns.label: Contracciones en preguntas
patterns.pattern: What is → What's; Where is → Where's

No, I'm not. I'm a teacher.

grammar.note: En preguntas de sí/no, are va antes de you.
Where aparece antes de are y del sujeto.

content.audioTranscript: At Green School, teacher Anna meets two new students, Mia and Leo. Anna asks Mia, 'What's your name?' Mia says, 'My name is Mia.' Anna asks, 'How old are you?' Mia answers, 'I'm eighteen.' Anna asks, 'Where are you from?' Mia says, 'I'm from Cardiff.' Anna asks, 'Are you a student?' Mia answers, 'Yes, I am.' Anna turns to Leo and asks, 'What's your name?' He says, 'I'm Leo.' Anna asks, 'Are you from Wales too?' Leo answers, 'No, I'm not. I'm from Spain.' Anna asks, 'How old are you?' Leo says, 'I'm twenty.' Anna asks, 'Is Mia your classmate?' Leo says, 'Yes, she is.' Anna smiles and asks, 'Are you both ready for class?' Mia and Leo answer, 'Yes, we are!'
